events.summary: The explorers find Argoth a storehouse of natural wealth.
events.quote: The first explorers found Argoth a storehouse of natural wealth

events.summary: Temporal manipulation is banned at Tolaria West.
events.quote: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

events.summary: The crabs of Tolaria migrate to the sea in the final days before the disaster.
events.quote: In the final days before the disaster, all the crabs on Tolaria migrated from inlets, streams, and ponds back to the sea.

events.summary: Liliana tells a victim she will take only their most precious secret.
events.quote: "Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."

events.summary: The Gixians reduce a person to something unrecognizable after six days.
events.quote: After six days in the hands of the Gixians, what remained was utterly unrecognizable as the person it once was.

events.summary: Tahngarth relishes bloodying his blades on those who ravaged his home.
events.quote: Tahngarth relished the chance to bloody his blades on those who had ravaged his home.

events.summary: Urza realizes the Phyrexians will resist him even if he tears every one to pieces.
events.quote: Urza saw the wall and realized that even if he tore every Phyrexian to pieces, they would still resist him.

events.summary: As the world steels itself for the New Phyrexian invasion, a new maro-sorcerer awakens in the Pinelands.
events.quote: As the world steeled itself for the New Phyrexian invasion, the heart of the Pinelands awoke, and a new maro-sorcerer strode forth to join the fight.

events.summary: Karona turns her wrath on the world that birthed her.
events.quote: Tormented by her own existence, Karona turned her wrath on the world that had birthed her.

events.summary: The Legacy Weapon obliterates Yawgmoth, letting Urza rest.
events.quote: In a single blinding flash, Yawgmoth was obliterated, and Urza could finally rest.

events.summary: Captain Velkarne lays down his sword and takes up the poet's quill after glimpsing a muse.
events.quote: A single glimpse was enough to compel Captain Velkarne to lay down his sword and take up the poet's quill.

events.summary: Sheoldred orders the killing of all survivors.
Liliana says she is saving a victim for later.
events.quote: "Oh, don't worry about that one. I'm saving him for later."

relations.note: unwelcoming of humans; weak link only to forest
relations.quote: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."
